mu_name: The small bone a skeleton comes apart into
mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp, the same loop as Bone01: MODEL_BONE2 is Data/Skill/Bone02.bmd.
why_this_one: Ten of these per skeleton - `for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) CreateEffect(MODEL_BONE2, ...)` in CharacterDie - to one Bone01.
mesh_from: muextract export-obj on Data/Skill/Bone02.bmd, from MuMain. Thirty-two triangles in one mesh on bons_particle.jpg: a single long bone, 60 units end to end.

parts.note: The same 64-square as Bone01's, solid and lit.

scale_from: As Bone01: 0.8 to 1.1, rolled per bone at the throw.
lift_from: `case MODEL_BONE2: o->Position[2] += 100.f;` - born a metre up, under the large bone's 150.
flight_note: The same ballistic arm as Bone01, whose flight_note has the numbers and the one departure.
